definitions: A large prehistoric lake that covered much of present-day northwestern Nevada and parts of California and Oregon during the last ice age.
A desert shrub (Sarcobatus vermiculatus) native to the western United States, often found in areas that were once part of Lake Lahontan.
A variety of cutthroat trout (Oncorhynchus clarkii henshawi) native to the Lahontan basin.
examples: Lake Lahontan was a massive pluvial lake.
The Lahontan cutthroat trout is an endangered species.
Lahontan sagebrush is common in the Great Basin.
